integrity: The proof is analytic and uses no numerical root search or unverified computation. The highly relevant 2026 preprint was inspected in full-text form through its definitions, main theorem, and complete bipyramid argument; the 2009 precursor was inspected at the directly relevant elongated-body remark. A published comparison record giving an explicit lower zero-free strip was compared at the level of its indexed scientific claim; the underlying full package was not accessible during review, which is retained as a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact leading coefficient is characterized as the sharp transverse zero threshold rho_d; no closed form, attainment theorem, minimizing zero, or finite-alpha crossing threshold is claimed.
title: Exact leading slope of Fourier-zero distance for elongated bipyramids
